reason: The README clearly describes a CDP-based plugin for automating a dedicated Chrome instance, including navigation, tab management, page inspection, interaction, screenshots, and read-only evaluation.

summaries.zh: 通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 控制专用 Chrome 实例，支持标签页管理、网页导航、DOM 快照、页面交互、截图和只读脚本求值。
summaries.en: Controls a dedicated Chrome instance through the Chrome DevTools Protocol for tab management, navigation, DOM snapshots, page interaction, screenshots, and read-only script evaluation.

capabilities: Launches and closes a dedicated Chrome instance
Reads visible DOM snapshots and page status
Clicks, types, sends keypresses, and scrolls in web pages
Performs read-only JavaScript evaluation in pages
Communicates with Chrome through the DevTools Protocol
